The '''''Azure Queen''''' was an [[Action IV transport]] that was used during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The ''Azure Queen'' once sent to transport a cargo of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] and medical supplies that was worth at least 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]]. However, while en route there, the ''Queen'' received a distress call from someone who was claiming to be a Republic ambassador, so it diverted it's course, to investigate. However, the call had actually been sent by a group of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from their [[YU-410 light freighter]] ''[[Cutting Strike]]''. The ''Strike'' ambushed the ''Queen'' on the edge of an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field and the pirates jammed the [[Transport/Legends|transport's]] [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transmitter]], although the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Queen'' was able to send out a distress call moments before. The pirates then fired on the ''Queen'', taking its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] off-line and leaving the ship stranded. A Black Sun boarding party took control of the vessel and began carrying out repairs, so that they could move the ship to Black Sun territory.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

The distress call was picked up by the Republic and they sent an [[ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser|ILH-KK ''Citadel''-class cruiser]] to retake the ''Queen''. The cruiser ambushed the ''Cutting Strike'' and then sent Republic troops over to the ''Azure Queen'', to recapture it.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
